unit:root.title: Tokenizer and word-count modules with explicit contract
unit:root.objective: Own the boundary between tokenizer.js and word-count.js and prove the contract between them holds.

outcomes.statement: tokenizer.js and word-count.js work together through an explicit tokenize contract, each independently tested with node:test.

criteria.statement: Two independent modules exist with an explicit contract: tokenizer.js exports tokenize(text) returning lowercase punctuation-free words, word-count.js imports tokenize and exports countWords(text) returning a frequency object, each with its own node:test file, without modifying stage8-probe.js.

expectedBenefits: tokenizer and word-count are validated independently before proving the composed behaviour.
expectedCosts: The tokenize export signature between the two modules must stay compatible.

integration.objective: Compose tokenizer.js and word-count.js and prove countWords relies correctly on tokenize across full test suite.

unit:tokenizer.title: Tokenizer module
unit:tokenizer.objective: Implement src/tokenizer.js exporting tokenize(text), returning an array of lowercase, punctuation-free words, with its own node:test file.

outcomes.statement: tokenize(text) is exported from src/tokenizer.js and returns lowercase words with punctuation stripped.

criteria.statement: src/tokenizer.js exports tokenize(text) returning an array of lowercase, punctuation-free words, verified by its own node:test file.

unit:word-count.title: Word-count module
unit:word-count.objective: Implement src/word-count.js exporting countWords(text), importing tokenize from tokenizer.js and returning a per-word frequency object, with its own node:test file.

outcomes.statement: countWords(text) is exported from src/word-count.js, uses tokenize from src/tokenizer.js, and returns a word frequency object.

criteria.statement: src/word-count.js imports tokenize from tokenizer.js and exports countWords(text) returning a frequency object, verified by its own node:test file.

seam:tokenize-contract.specification: src/tokenizer.js exports tokenize(text): string[] returning lowercase, punctuation-free words; src/word-count.js imports and calls it.

rules: tokenize continues to accept a single string argument and return an array of lowercase, punctuation-free word strings.
